package.name: nepi_gazebo_plugins
package.description: Gazebo model plugins for NEPI simulated robots. First plugin: nepi_crab_steer_plugin, a purely kinematic per-wheel steering+spin animator for the 4-wheel rover's "wheel independence" (crab-steering) dimension option -- additive alongside the stock libgazebo_ros_planar_move plugin, which handles the rover's actual body-frame translation physics. See sim_container/scripts/generate_model_sdf.py's buildRoverSdf for the SDF wiring that references this plugin's built .so.
